newsitem.title: BRAZIL: France Telecom, Brazil firms join to bid on Band B.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom, Brazil firms join to bid on Band B.

text.p: France Telecom's international mobile telephone unit has teamed with Brazil's Evadin group and local investment bank Garantia to bid on concessions to operate cellular services on the B Band frequency, the firms said.

France Telecom Mobiles International, Teldin Telecomunicacoes Evadin S.A. and private equity funds managed by Garantia have formed a consortium to take part in the B Band privatization, the statement said.
Bids are due April 7 on 10 B Band concessions being offered by the government, with contracts slated to awarded in May or June.
The auctions have drawn the eye of the world's biggest cellular operators and represent the first opening of Brazil's promising cellular market to foreign capital.
France Telecom is the world's fourth-largest telecoms firm, with consolidated annual sales of $29.6 billion and a profit of $1.8 billion in 1995, the statement said.
The Evadin group is one of Brazil's largest consumer electronics goods firms, with annual sales of about $1 billion.
Banco Garantia de Investimentos manages some $500 million in private equities funds seeking investment opportunities in Brazil, it said.
